title: AI Christmas Photo Generator
summary: Free AI Christmas photo generator: turn a photo of your family, partner or pet into a cozy Christmas portrait or holiday card, with every prompt to copy.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI Christmas photo generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every Christmas photo on this page from a family or couple photo, costs 5 credits an image.


### How do I make an AI Christmas photo of myself?


Add a clear photo of yourself as a reference image, describe the Christmas scene, outfit and light you want, and name the features that must stay, such as your hair, glasses or freckles, so the result still looks like you.


### What are popular AI Christmas photo ideas?


Popular AI Christmas photo ideas include matching family pajamas by the tree, a cozy fireplace portrait, a couple on a snowy street or at a Christmas market, a pet in a Santa hat, a family inside a snow globe and a vintage holiday card.


### Can I make a Christmas card with AI?


Yes. Describe the photo and ask for a short greeting in quotes, such as Merry Christmas or Happy Holidays, with the words spelled exactly as written, and add a border or a vintage paper look if you want it to read as a card.


### Can I put my whole family and our pet in one Christmas photo?


Yes. Use a photo with everyone in it, or add one photo per person or pet and say who comes from which photo; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Can I turn an AI Christmas photo into a video?


Yes. Use the Christmas photo as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as falling snow, a slow walk or flickering firelight, and ask it to keep the faces and clothes the same.
